The signature of a metadata_handler is now

  int handle_metadata\(readstat_metadata_t *metadata, void *ctx\)

With lots of accessor functions to pull information out of the metadata
struct. This includes everything formerly passed to info_handler and
metadata_handler \(row count, var count, file label, timestamp, etc\), as
well as some new fields such as compression, file_format_is_64bit, and
table_name. In the future more metadata can be added without breaking
existing programs \(or adding more handlers\), but for now... sorry.

Most applications will need to combine the two handlers into one and use
the new accessor functions inside their callbacks.")

API change: Combine info_handler and metadata_handler

The signature of a metadata_handler is now

  int handle_metadata(readstat_metadata_t *metadata, void *ctx)

With lots of accessor functions to pull information out of the metadata
struct. This includes everything formerly passed to info_handler and
metadata_handler (row count, var count, file label, timestamp, etc), as
well as some new fields such as compression, file_format_is_64bit, and
table_name. In the future more metadata can be added without breaking
existing programs (or adding more handlers), but for now... sorry.

Most applications will need to combine the two handlers into one and use
the new accessor functions inside their callbacks.

Fix issues with truncated UTF-8 in SAV files

This was more work than I expected, but to avoid problems with truncated
UTF-8, store the name and longname as unconverted bytes for most of the
SAV file processing, and only convert them to the requested encoding
right before the variable handler is called.

Also fix a bug with unconverted labels in POR files.

Cross-endian fixes

Previously decompressing a file with byteswapping turned off produced
correct values for compressed values (missing and biased numbers),
but incorrect values for uncompressed values. Instead of flipping off
byteswapping altogether, pre-swap compressed values during decompression
so that they're swapped a second time during row processing. Make sense?

Also cross-endian reading of ZSAV files appears to have been broken
altogether.

value.value: API change: Combine info_handler and metadata_handler

API change: Combine info_handler and metadata_handler

The signature of a metadata_handler is now

  int handle_metadata(readstat_metadata_t *metadata, void *ctx)

With lots of accessor functions to pull information out of the metadata
struct. This includes everything formerly passed to info_handler and
metadata_handler (row count, var count, file label, timestamp, etc), as
well as some new fields such as compression, file_format_is_64bit, and
table_name. In the future more metadata can be added without breaking
existing programs (or adding more handlers), but for now... sorry.

Most applications will need to combine the two handlers into one and use
the new accessor functions inside their callbacks.
